critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py: Seed function had three find_one({'email': '[email protected]'}) queries which were broken email obfuscation literals. Old admin user with bad email was deleted and Andi/Budi student parent_ids were repaired to point to the correct parent uuid.

Backend code overall: clean, FastAPI + Motor, proper Pydantic validation, JWT bcrypt, role gating with require_role, mongodb _id excluded via projection. Good role-based filtering on /students and /payments for parent users.
Login screen demo emails appear obfuscated in the UI; either move to login.tsx fix or accept as-is.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: server.py was authored with email-like strings that got rendered/obfuscated as the literal text '[email protected]' in multiple places: (1) admin demo user seed (email='[email protected]') causing login admin@ssb.id to return 401, (2) three subsequent db.users.find_one({'email':'[email protected]'}) lookups used to attach parent_id to seeded children and created_by for announcements/sessions — these returned the bad admin user, so Andi/Budi had parent_id pointing to admin's uuid, breaking parent-scoped student listing. REPRODUCTION: POST /api/auth/login with admin@ssb.id/admin123 → 401 Invalid credentials. GET /api/students with parent token → empty list even though parent has 2 children. MITIGATION: replaced admin seed email with admin@ssb.id, replaced 3 broken find_one lookups with role-based queries, deleted leftover bad admin row, updated Andi/Budi parent_id in DB to the correct parent uuid. All 22 backend tests now pass.
